body: scripts/serve.py: Python stdlib HTTP server loads HF checkpoint at startup, serves POST /generate (prompt/max_tokens/temperature) and GET /health. No flask/fastapi dependency. Tested: model loads in <1s, inference works end-to-end. src/main.c: --prompt TEXT flag added; tokenizes via gpt2_encode, generates, decodes via gpt2_decode. scripts/build_tokenizer_bin.py: converts tokenizer.json to C binary format (50257 tokens, 50000 merges, 1.1MB). EMILY emily-agent: POST /api/v1/gpt2/generate + GET /api/v1/gpt2/health proxy endpoints in api_gpt2.go. Makefile: make tokenizer target.
title: S26: GPT-2 inference API endpoint live on :8088
